svg.title: Normal and overlap scheduler loops
svg.desc: In the normal loop the CPU schedules a batch, the GPU runs it, and the CPU processes the result before scheduling the next one, so the GPU waits. In the overlap loop the CPU schedules batch N plus one while the GPU runs batch N and processes the result of batch N one step late. The next decode input is gathered on the GPU from the future map.
svg.text: GPU IDLES WHILE THE CPU SCHEDULES AND PROCESSES RESULTS
RESULTS ARE PROCESSED ONE BATCH LATE · NEXT INPUT_IDS STAY ON THE GPU
